blog_posts_published_has_date.name: blog_posts_published_has_date
blog_posts_published_has_date.value: status <> 'published' OR published_at IS NOT NULL

budget_allocations_contribution_check.name: budget_allocations_contribution_check
budget_allocations_contribution_check.value: contribution_status is null or contribution_status in ('planned','confirmed','missed','skipped')

budget_commitments_discriminant_check.name: budget_commitments_discriminant_check
budget_commitments_discriminant_check.value: (kind = 'one_time' and due_date is not null and recurring_rule_id is null) or (kind = 'recurring' and recurring_rule_id is not null)

budget_envelopes_funding_mode_check.name: budget_envelopes_funding_mode_check
budget_envelopes_funding_mode_check.value: funding_mode is null or funding_mode in ('virtual','space_backed')

budget_envelopes_space_backed_check.name: budget_envelopes_space_backed_check
budget_envelopes_space_backed_check.value: funding_mode <> 'space_backed' or wealth_account_id is not null

budget_occurrences_reschedule_moves_chec.name: budget_occurrences_reschedule_moves_check
budget_occurrences_reschedule_moves_chec.value: rescheduled_to is null or rescheduled_to <> due_date

budget_period_snapshots_reason_check.name: budget_period_snapshots_reason_check
budget_period_snapshots_reason_check.value: restated_reason is null or restated_reason in ('transaction_edited','transaction_deleted','transaction_restored','backdated_transaction','settlement_received','manual')

budget_plans_anchor_check.name: budget_plans_anchor_check
budget_plans_anchor_check.value: anchor_day is null or (anchor_day between 1 and 31)

budget_plans_custom_days_check.name: budget_plans_custom_days_check
budget_plans_custom_days_check.value: custom_days is null or (custom_days between 1 and 400)

wealth_accounts_one_default_idx.name: wealth_accounts_one_default_idx
wealth_accounts_one_default_idx.where: is_default = true AND archived_at IS NULL
